layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: Grid Borders: use 1px solid borders (border-[#1A4331]/15) without heavy drop shadows to create a technical, agricultural ledger feel. Subtle rounded corners (rounded-xl).

button.primary: bg-[#1A4331] text-white hover:bg-[#1A4331]/90 transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium shadow-sm
button.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1A4331]/20 text-[#1A4331] hover:bg-[#1A4331]/5 transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-2.5 font-medium

components.cards: bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#1A4331]/15 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm
components.navigation: bg-[#FFFFFF]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#1A4331]/15 sticky top-0 z-50
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold bg-[#1A4331]/10 text-[#1A4331] uppercase tracking-wider

images.description: Aerial view of the Christmas tree yard, for login page background or main dashboard header.
Mockup of the CCTV feed for the Owner Dashboard.
Lorry profile picture for load management screens.
Stack of wooden pallets for inventory placeholders.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] and shadow increase for interactive cards.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Design an application for Wilson Contractors (Trees.wilson-contractors.co.uk).
Use a Light Theme with the 'Organic & Earthy' archetype. The app is a logistics dashboard used on desktop and iPad.
Set the main page background color to #F4F1ED (warm sand) and use #FFFFFF for content cards.
Implement a sticky header with a glassmorphism effect (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl).
In the Owner Dashboard, include a 'Live Camera Feed' widget using the provided mock CCTV image.
For the Lorry Loading Map, build a 2D grid representation of a flatbed lorry where users can assign pallets visually. Use a technical grid style.
Pallet management should use color-coded badges for Pallet tree colors (e.g., Red, Blue, Green labels). Include a QR Code generation visual or modal.
Utilize Shadcn UI for tables, dialogs (manifest printing), and dropdowns, but heavily customize them with the #1A4331 primary color and rounded-xl borders.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive and touch-friendly for iPad usage, stacking neatly into 1-2 columns on tablets, and 3-4 columns on desktop.
